audit.why: 46.68% over 557 games; packet chart is Gragas on all seven rows and both layers already agree, matching the mirror audit which also left the chart alone.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level-6 spike blamed a 'W shield' and gave no cooldown for Explosive Cask, so the reader had no way to time the window where the spike does not exist.
audit.why: Gragas R is 100/85/70s. Drunken Rage (W, 5s) is damage reduction plus a bonus-damage attack, not a shield.
audit.corrected: spikes[1].text rewritten with the 100s rank-1 cooldown and the real damage-reduction wording.

audit.whatIsWrong: Happy Hour is called 'Happy Hour (W)' and its healing is attributed to W in four places. Happy Hour is the passive; W is Drunken Rage. The page also calls Drunken Rage a shield twice.
audit.why: Kit: P Happy Hour 'periodically heals upon using a skill'; W Drunken Rage 'dealing magic damage to all nearby enemies on his next basic attack and reducing damage received'. Damage reduction and a shield behave differently against Soul Ignition's true damage.
audit.corrected: Slots and mechanics corrected in whys[1], spikes[0].text, spikes[1].text, early, mid and wants.foe[0].

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Barrel Roll out-ranges everything you have' is false. Barrel Roll is 850; Ritual Nails is 950 — you own the poke range and lose the lane to Body Slam and the cask knockback instead.
audit.why: Kit ranges: Gragas Q 850, Locke Q 950. Same class of error the Galio page carried.
audit.corrected: early rewritten to state both numbers; whys[0] no longer claims a range edge.

audit.whatIsWrong: Body Slam is the tracked cooldown on every panel but its duration never appears, and its stun is never named.
audit.corrected: report[5].t and whys[1] now carry the 14s rank-1 number and the stun.

audit.why: packet.suspectNames flagged 'His Explosive Cask' and 'Body Slams' — both are false positives from the near-miss matcher; the underlying names are right.

edits.before: Level 1 is Gragas — Barrel Roll (Q) out-ranges you and starts the chip war.
edits.after: Level 1 is Gragas — Barrel Roll (Q) plus Happy Hour heals win the chip war.

edits.before: Level 2 is Gragas as Body Slam (E) plus W sustain wins the melee trade.
edits.after: Level 2 is Gragas — Body Slam (E, 14s) stun plus Happy Hour wins the trade.

edits.before: Gragas bullies you with Barrel Roll (Q) poke and Body Slam (E) trades that proc his Happy Hour (W) sustain, out-healing your P Silver Stake chip and shoving you off the wave.
edits.after: Gragas bullies you with Barrel Roll (Q) poke and Body Slam (E) stuns, and every cast procs Happy Hour (P) to out-heal your Silver Stake chip while Drunken Rage (W) cuts the damage you land back.

edits.before: His Explosive Cask (R) is the problem for your all-in: even under your Purgatory (R) threshold he can knock you out of totem range, and his W shield eats your W Soul Ignition burst.
edits.after: Explosive Cask (R, 100s at rank 1) is the problem for your all-in: he knocks you clean out of the Purgatory zone before the threshold resolves, and Drunken Rage's damage reduction blunts the burst.

edits.before: Gragas owns levels 1-2: his Barrel Roll (Q) out-ranges everything you have and Happy Hour (W) refunds the trade damage your P chips in. Don't walk up to last-hit into a charged Q, and never contest melee range while his Body Slam (E) is up.
edits.after: Gragas owns levels 1-2: Barrel Roll (Q) is 850 to your 950, so you can answer the poke, but Happy Hour (P) refunds every point your chip lands. Don't last-hit inside a charged cask, and never contest melee range while Body Slam (E, 14s) is up.

edits.before: This stays Gragas-favoured through 6. His W shield and sustain blunt your W Soul Ignition all-in, and Explosive Cask (R) can knock you clean out of Purgatory (R) totem range right as you commit. Only look for a kill if you bait both his E and R first.
edits.after: This stays Gragas-favoured through 6. Drunken Rage's damage reduction and Happy Hour healing blunt your Soul Ignition all-in, and Explosive Cask can knock you clean out of the Purgatory zone right as you commit. Only look for a kill once his E and R are spent.

edits.before: Poke with Q and heal on you via W
edits.after: Poke with Q and heal off casts via P

edits.before: Track Gragas’s Body Slam: His engage and his escape in one button — punish the cooldown hard. Commit only while it is down.
edits.after: Track Body Slam (14s at rank 1): his engage, escape and only stun in one button — step up while it is down, never before.

notes: Two systematic errors: Happy Hour was slotted as W (it is the passive, and W is Drunken Rage, damage reduction rather than a shield), and Barrel Roll was said to out-range you when it is 850 against your 950. The cask knocking you out of the Purgatory zone is the genuinely decisive interaction and it is now stated with its 100s cost.
